messages.text: Do the globes say Gulf of America or Mexico..... Lake America or Lake Ontario..... thanks

That's a great question, and I want to give you an accurate answer rather than guess — our catalog listings don't specify which exact naming convention each map uses for bodies of water like that. It can vary by globe and edition (and whether it was made before or after certain naming changes), so the safest way to confirm is to check the specific product photos on the page, or email (email hidden) and ask about the exact model you're considering.

Is there a particular globe you're looking at? I can point you to its product page so you can zoom in on the map details yourself.
